::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** May 9th 1893  
**From:** Clovelly, Belgian Crescent Torquay  
**Manuscript:** MS Princeton University, Parrish Collection
:::

[Gentlemen](organizations/other_223.qmd)

The [Bishop of Winchester](people/person_1280.qmd)has given his permission - subject to yours - for the Readings on the Training of Children used in the [Good Words](organizations/other_73.qmd) for 1891 in one number, to appear in [Mothers in Council](organizations/other_82.qmd) (Wells Gardiner)[^1] Have I your permission so to use them 

I remain
Yours &c
C.M. Yonge

Editor of Mothers in Council

---

[^1]: The Rt. Rev. Anthony Wilson Thorold (1825–1895) was bishop of Winchester 1890-1895.
[^2]: Isbister published *Good Words*.
